blocking_gap.reachable_source_proof: Apple arg.c:1058-1069 continues after OpenDir failure, printing warning only if !Fwarn; lines1142-1151 continue after a failed selected-entry lstat with the same warning guard. main.c:880-882 sets Fterse=Fwarn=1 for -t.
